mcqs.question: In February 2026, who submitted the notice against Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, and on behalf of which parties?
options: K. Suresh on behalf of the Congress, SP and DMK
Rahul Gandhi on behalf of the Congress, SP and DMK
K. Suresh on behalf of the Congress and SP only
Om Birla on behalf of the SP and DMK
mcqs.explanation: Congress Chief Whip K. Suresh submitted the notice on behalf of the Congress, SP and DMK. Rahul Gandhi was associated with one of the stated grievances, but he was not identified as the notice’s submitter.
